request: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

actions.operation: Create a 3 cm deep rounded-rectangular opening.
actions.target: Lower back of the coffee machine.
actions.relational_constraint: Position the opening on the lower back, more or less equally distanced from the bottom and the sides of the device.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the lower-back face of the coffee machine and the applicable bottom and side boundaries from which the opening clearances are to be assessed. Exact equal-clearance distances and the orientation of the 20 cm and 10 cm dimensions are not specified.

intention: Provide a possible location for a plug and the main ON/OFF switch.
